questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{因为 } Y=\cos \lambda \, , \, \, \text{故} \\& P\{Y=0\}=P\{\cos X=0\}=P\{X=\pm \frac{\pi}{2}\}=P\{X=-\frac{\pi}{2}\}+P\{X=\frac{\pi}{2}\}=\frac{9}{16}\,, \\& P\{Y=\sqrt{2}/2\}=P\{\cos X=\sqrt{2}/2\}=P\{X=\pm \frac{\pi}{4}\}=P\{X=\frac{\pi}{4}\}+P\{X=-\frac{\pi}{4}\}=\frac{5}{16}\,, \\& P\{Y=1\}=P\{\cos X=1\}=P\{X=0\}=\frac{1}{8}\,.\end{aligned}
